$comment: Quality harness configuration. One place to tune enforcement, reviewers, and model costs.

boundaries.$comment: Feature-based structure (docs/clean-code.md §10). severity: warn (report-only) or error (blocks via eslint gate). Set enabled:false for repos not yet feature-sliced. shared/app accept a string or array of paths.

logging.$comment: Run artifacts + agent tool-call log under .harness/runs/. Observability only — never blocks.

models.$comment: reviewer: opus — strongest Claude model for review-style reasoning (multi-file logic, explanation quality); runs once per turn so the extra cost is bounded. Drop to sonnet for ~1/5 the price at slightly lower quality.

subagentReview.$comment: Peer review by a Claude subagent, enforced at the Stop hook: the activity log must show a run of this agent newer than the engineer's last edit, else the stop blocks with instructions to run it. Fast first pass; codex (llmReview) stays the independent final check.

llmReview.$comment: Second-pair-of-eyes review at the Stop hook, after gate.sh passes. mode: 'block' feeds VERDICT: FAIL findings back to the engineer via exit 2; 'advisory' only saves the report to .harness/runs/. maxRounds caps review-fix-review cycles per turn.

reviewers.name: codex
reviewers.command: codex exec --sandbox read-only "Review the diff between {base} and HEAD strictly against docs/clean-code.md. Report clear violations only, with file:line and the clean-code.md section each one breaks. Separate sections: Standards, Spec (skip Spec if no issue/PRD is referenced). End your reply with exactly one line: 'VERDICT: PASS' if there are no clear violations, or 'VERDICT: FAIL' if there are."

reviewers.name: third-party-pr
reviewers.$comment: CodeRabbit/Greptile install via their GitHub App; this entry documents the slot.
